assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: small catalog illustration for a stage-audio routing application. Generate exactly ONE unbranded generic DI box, not a real manufacturer product. Clean realistic studio product illustration on pure white background, square image, three-quarter overhead view showing the top and input face, all edges fully visible with 10 percent margin. Dark graphite powder-coated rectangular metal chassis, small silver jack sockets, restrained pale lettering. Strong recognizability at thumbnail size. No brand, no logo, no imitation Radial branding, no cables, no extra equipment, no external captions, no collage or multiple angles. Subject: compact MONO PASSIVE direct box, one signal channel. Front face has exactly two quarter-inch jack sockets side by side labelled "INPUT" and "THRU", one small ground-lift switch. One balanced XLR output is on the rear face, can remain out of view. Top text verbatim "PASSIVE" and on the next line "MONO DI". No power LED, no power switch. Neutral industrial catalog aesthetic.
